fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Move-in 6-7 Sep, Orientation 9 Sep, Classes 10 Sep - 9 Dec, Finals 11-18 Dec, Move-out 19 Dec 2026 (Fall Intensive: 15 Oct - 19 Dec 2026).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Move-in 10-11 Jan, Orientation 12 Jan, Classes 14 Jan - 14 Apr, Finals 16-23 Apr, Move-out 24 Apr 2027 (also Summer 2027 Term 16 May - 15 Jul; Sessions I & II May-Jul).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ACG- The American College of Greece/2026-2027/Academic Calendar 2026_2027_Study Abroad.pdf#page=1

tuition_model.notes: Exchange Partner Info Sheet #page=2 states tuition and fees are handled 'per agreement with each institution' rather than unambiguously proving unconditional waiver; independent non-US students pay Comprehensive Study Abroad Fees (https://www.acg.edu/admissions/study-abroad/inbound-study-abroad/tuition-fees-non-us-students/).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: acg.edu/admissions/study-abroad/inbound-study-abroad/tuition-fees-non-us-students/ budgets EUR 3,000/semester for daily living/meals/transport and EUR 300/semester for books excluding housing (which is bundled into Comprehensive Fees); no total all-in monthly living range published.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Cannot be derived without an all-in housing-inclusive monthly living cost figure.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition & fees per bilateral agreement (Exchange Partner Info Sheet #page=2); ACG budgets ~EUR 300/semester for books and ~EUR 3,000/semester for personal/meals/transport excluding housing (https://www.acg.edu/admissions/study-abroad/inbound-study-abroad/tuition-fees-non-us-students/).

housing_notes.value: Furnished apartments in Aghia Paraskevi with equipped kitchens managed via ACG Study Abroad Housing (https://www.acg.edu/admissions/study-abroad/inbound-study-abroad/housing-at-acg/; check-in/out aligned to semester move-in/move-out calendar).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Greek student visa process should begin ~10 weeks prior to term start (Exchange Partner Info Sheet #page=2; guidance at https://www.acg.edu/admissions/student-visa).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ACG- The American College of Greece/Exchange Partner Info Sheet.pdf#page=2

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit system (NEASC + OU UK accredited; 128 credits/BA, most courses 3 credits); maximum load 15 credits in Fall/Spring and 6 credits in Summer.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/ACG- The American College of Greece/Exchange Partner Info Sheet.pdf#page=2
